text: The Applicant for 125 Presley Avenue has requested Scarborough Community Council to exempt their property from the following by-law requirements: City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 447 1.2B(1) – Restrictions on Fences; Height. The fence in the rear yard on the east side of the property has a height ranging from 2.84 meters to 2.87 meters. This is higher than the allowable 2.5 meters. The fence in the rear yard on the north side of the property has a height ranging from 2.26 meters to 2.87 meters. This is higher than the allowable 2 meters. Municipal Licensing and Standards Division has inspected the subject property and issued a notice of violation of City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 447 1.2(B)(1).

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Granted a fence exemption permit to the property owner of 125 Presley Avenue and that at such time as replacement of the fence is required, the installation comply with Municipal Code Chapter 447, Fences, or its successor by-law.
